response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with nearly two decades of software development across web, backend, and systems work, but he falls well short of the role's core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience — his C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments and a thesis project. His high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic (DLang, millions of requests/sec) is relevant, but his career centers on full-stack product engineering in TypeScript/Node.js rather than cloud compute platform architecture, and he lacks demonstrated formal technical leadership of cloud/DevOps teams at scale.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience at Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Broad, deep engineering craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling) plus mentoring via workshops, courses, and talks
Long track record of ownership, including founding and maintaining an open-source geo-data platform on Kubernetes
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (roughly under 1 year professionally)
Limited large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure architecture experience; background is mostly product-focused full-stack work
No formal technical leadership role managing priorities, deadlines, and cross-team alignment for a platform team
